scope: read-only code review, offline UAT, synthetic counterexamples, public static asset comparison

uat.note: Passing existing tests does not cover the counterexamples below. Counts are suite-reported, not a count of complete business capabilities.

counterexamples.case: entity A spend10 orders10; B spend100 orders0; parent action scale_up
counterexamples.expected: evaluate entity facts separately; missing exit cannot satisfy complete business gate

counterexamples.case: existing one-image product enriched with three Sorftime images
counterexamples.expected: preserve the complete ordered source gallery and source identity

counterexamples.case: synthetic Sorftime content contains code500 and data.title
counterexamples.expected: known failure envelopes fail closed; validate actual provider business envelope before accepting facts
counterexamples.qualification: synthetic defensive case, not a claim about the live provider's error schema

counterexamples.expected: select unit from versioned field schema, not magnitude

counterexamples.case: one expected image-element with unknown/low and no source or region
counterexamples.expected: coverage can be recorded; unknown observation cannot be counted as judged evidence

counterexamples.case: three complete competitor records; own product has ASIN only
counterexamples.expected: own-product incompleteness must affect comparison readiness

counterexamples.case: rope lights unrelated clicks12 spend3 orders0; indoor rope lights related clicks30 spend90 orders0
counterexamples.expected: related keyword remains protected regardless of diagnostic bucket

counterexamples.case: one negative row has clicks null and relevance unknown
counterexamples.expected: count unique qualified rows; coverage is between zero and total

counterexamples.case: market share0.2 and dependency0.05 without denominator/ASIN/period
counterexamples.expected: unverified denominator semantics and identity cannot produce complete share evidence

counterexamples.case: clicks100 spend100 orders1 sales10; no market opportunity score
counterexamples.expected: uncovered high-cost case is explicitly unjudged/review, not healthy hold

counterexamples.case: organic rank1; ACOS0.2; tolerance0.3; defense cap0.1
counterexamples.expected: honor the separately configured defense cost ceiling
